messages:
Mira: Heads-up: new webinar concept 'Practical Inference Playbook' 90min deep-dive proposed for May 12. Target audience: ML engineers + infra leads. Need volunteers for topic leads and a run-of-show that keeps it technical but beginner-friendly.

Sam: Love it. Suggest split into 4 modules: 1) Metrics & SLAs (15m), 2) Cost engineering patterns (20m), 3) Demo: autoscale & fallbacks (25m), 4) Live troubleshooting + Q&A (30m).

Ish: I'll cover cost engineering patterns. Need to show real numbers and e2e impact of batching + quantization. Can we use anonymized customer numbers?

Mira: Yes, legal ok with sanitized telemetry. Please surface the exact fields you need by Wed.

Sam: For the demo94I can script an autoscale spike and graceful fallback. Will need eng-runtime assistance and a ticket for an extra instance. Ops-bot: create infra ticket?

ops-bot: Ticket created: #INF-4821 (Request: ephemeral instance for webinar demo). ETA: 48h.

Mira: Run-of-show draft (90m):
- 00:00-00:08 Mira: Welcome + context + goals
- 00:08-00:23 Ish: Metrics & SLAs (latency SLOs, p95/p99 tradeoffs)
- 00:23-00:45 Ish: Cost engineering patterns (batching, KV cache, cold-start mitigation)
- 00:45-01:10 Sam: Live demo (scale up, routing to cheaper model, controlled failure)
- 01:10-01:30 Panel: Live troubleshooting & audience Qs (Mira + Ish + Sam)

Mira: Rehearsals: Tech run Mon 10 PT, Dry run Thu 16 PT. Slide deadline Fri EOD. Recording & captions enabled.

Sam: Can we include a short poll in the first 5 mins: "What's your biggest constraint? cost / latency / reliability / team ops"? Good for tailoring live answers.

Ish: Yes, add poll. Also request a short pre-webinar slack thread in #general to gather questions.

Mira: Good call. I'll draft invite copy and the poll.

Sam: Also recommend a 2-slide cheat sheet PDF for attendees post-webinar with config snippets and commands.

Mira: Agreed. Ish, can you draft the cheat sheet?

Ish: Yep, will have first draft by Thu.

ops-bot: Calendar invites sent for rehearsal windows.

Mira: Thanks team. Action items: Ish list telemetry fields by Wed, Sam attach demo script, all slides by Fri EOD.
